# Rodent Control Truckee

> Rodent Control Truckee provides mice and rat removal for homes, second homes, and vacation rentals in Truckee, California, zip code 96161. Services include inspection, trapping and exclusion, and sealing entry points using materials built for freeze and thaw winters. The company works only on rodents, not general pest control.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://rodentcontroltruckeeca.com/): Overview of rodent control services in Truckee, including seasonal rodent behavior, second home and rental protection, and signs of a rodent problem.
- [Rat Removal Truckee](https://rodentcontroltruckeeca.com/rat-removal-truckee/): Norway rat and roof rat identification, removal process, and rat specific signs and FAQs.
- [Mice Control Truckee](https://rodentcontroltruckeeca.com/mice-control-truckee/): House mouse and deer mouse identification, removal process, and mice specific signs and FAQs.

## Service Area

Downtown Truckee, Glenshire, Donner Lake, Prosser Lakeview, Hobart Mills, Martis Camp, Lahontan, and Northstar, all within Truckee's 96161 zip code.
